title: Irshad al-Fuhul
originalTitle: إرشاد الفحول إلى تحقيق الحق من علم الأصول
author: al-shawkani
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: Al-Shawkani's survey of legal theory, which reports the positions of the schools on each question and then states his own, consistently arguing for independent reasoning from the texts over adherence to a school.
historicalContext: Al-Shawkani, chief judge of Sana'a, came from a Zaydi background and became one of the most influential advocates of ijtihad before the modern reform movements. This transcription keeps the modern editors' introductions that precede the author's text.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
